description: Militech Black Site: APEX. Features a lore friendly quest, player safehouse, garage, other smaller buildings and an overhaul of the surrounding area into 'Sonora Canyon'.

name: Marmur Bank (Watson District Branch)
description: Marmur Bank has opened up in Night City!

name: RIOT penthouse - apartment
description: cozy penthouse with wall to wall city views

name: Night City Flooded
description: Add various bodies of water across the game world at non-intrusive locations, fully customizable experience through Native Settings UI now !

name: Baskin Office Location - Japantown
description: Adds a small office space intended to be used with the Baskin Job mod but can be used as standalone.

name: Pacifica_Beach_House
description: This is the decoration of a house in the beach area of Pacifica, with a pretty good view of the Night City pier. It includes some basic interactions to make the gameplay more comfortable.

name: Dedka Car Dealership - Working Vehicle Shop Framework
description: Dedka Dealership is a location that allows you to purchase any vehicles physically at a showroom. Fully compatible with Virtual Car Dealer and Auto Fixer.

name: Neon Isolation
description: A netrunners hideout in Kabuki.

name: A Gift For Jack - Columbarium
description: V left an offering for Jackie at his columbarium niche after attending his ofrenda. Next time you're in North Oak, visit the columbarium to find the gifts.

name: Silicon Mirage Villa
description: Enjoy your small oasis with a view of the Night City.

name: Chill Heywood Apartment
description: A new apartment now available in Heywood. Featuring several custom interactable items and a store located on the ground floor.

name: Under the bridge
description: A new location for my quest project based on the Strange Insight radio.

name: The Moth Bar Lair
description: The Moth Lair GOT AN UPGRADE! The Bars Secret Lair has been fitted for WAR with every Gun you could think of, all the Mechs and every bit of Information on Dogtown displayed from the Master Control Center!

name: Santo Domingo Player Home and Garage
description: Have you ever wanted to own your own home and property in the suburbs of Night City? There is now such a property available to purchase in the Rancho Coronado neighborhood in Santo Domingo !

name: NCPD Precinct
description: The Precinct in 2076. Before Vega and his C-team.

name: Grand Imperial Mall Theater
description: Can you believe that the Pacifica Gonks ACTUALLY figured out how to reroute the Malls backup power? God forbid they actually use that talent for anything else productive in Night City.....Now the Theater is Lit Up, Decorated and Ready to Watch Movies!

name: little china loft - apartment
description: tiny dark cluttered loft in little china

name: Liberty Walk Garage
description: Liberty Walk Garage for car modification shop mod.

name: DGT Arena Garage Safe Base
description: Secret Garage Apartment.

name: Impoverished Glen Apartment
description: YO CHOOM GANGOON ever wanted to be a disgusting, poor, lowlife but never had the apartment that suited your immersiveness? FEAR NOT, because this flat is here to make you feel all types of nasty, vile, best of all BROKE!!!

name: Dogtown Nomad Hideout Apartment - ArchiveXL
description: A hideout for nomads (and city nomads) in Dogtown, where they can fuel and repair their bikes.

name: Badlands Garage Safehouse (Militech)
description: Militech presence reported. Kill any hostiles found on arrival, and claim the place as your own.

name: Peralez Penthouse
description:
After the events with SSI and their election win, the Peralezes decided it was time for a change.
They moved to a new home, leaving this one behind… and in a gesture of gratitude, gifted it to you, V, for all you did.
It’s yours now — a quiet place in the hills… mostly quiet.
But tell me, have you noticed that he is watching

name: Kabuki Central Nights (Apartment)
description: I always fantasized about the idea that there is something real behind those fake reflections in the windows. So I made it true in Kabuki, with my favorite view: the Japantown skyline.

name: orbital nest - apartment
description: stark white space nest

name: Megabuilding H10 Ultimate Experience
description:
This mod improve the overhaul experience of the Megabuilding H10 by adding a tone of props and bring life in some of the dead areas of the building.

This is in addition to the H10 Megabuilding Unlocked and H10 Enhanced mod.

name: NeonShard Drug Lab
description: Small underground drug lab.

name: Impoverished Kabuki Apartment
description: Ever wanted to rp truly feel like you're living in an actual dystopian hellscape where rent is high, your environment is disgusting, you walk outside, and the smell of piss smacks you in the face? Well lucky for you i created this apartment JUST FOR YOU.

name: Neon Zen H10 Apartment
description: My Version of V's Original H10 Apartment in Watson. I removed most of the trash, added a kitchen area, a little window garden, custom made cat furniture for Nibbles and interactions for a more immersive gameplay.

name: pacifica pier hideout - apartment
description: grungey hideout at pacifica pier

name: Japantown Rooftop Temples
description: The GRAND OPENING of the Japantown Rooftop Temples is here ! The BRAND NEW Arasaka funded Rooftop Temples are a monument to all those who have fallen, protecting this Great City but also as a symbol of Arasakas Power and Wealth. High above the rest of Night Citys Japantown, even the dead now look down on the living peasants of Night City...

name: LongShore Hide out
description: LongShore Hide out, Hasan hide out enhancement.

name: GLEN_OASIS_Apartment
description: Updated overhaul of my Glen apartment edit. Features Archive XL for install and Native Interaction Framework to inject interactions.

name: The Glen - Netrunner Den
description: The Glen apartment now suited for a netrunner.

name: Nomad Trailer Apartment
description: A peaceful, fully interactive Nomad "Apartment" – On the plateau of the Aldecaldos camp. This Trailer is your quiet home between the chaos.

name: Mr. Blue Eyes and Akira Bodyguard (Dark Matter Club)
description: Add one of the most influential and enigmatic characters in all of Night City (Mr. Blue Eyes) along with his bodyguard Akira, offering you the entire iconic arsenal (ranged weapons and melee weapons).

name: Totentanz Club Unlocked
description: Unlocked all the closed areas of the Totentanz Club

name: Afterlife Expanded ( with Apartment )
description: The Bar Roof Entrance has been Renovated to allow AVs to land in Style without ever having to touch foot in Night City! Rogue's so impressed with your recent success that she even gave you a place to stay at the Bar!

name: Ho-Oh Casino Unlocked And Remastered
description: Unlocked all the locked doors in The OH-HO Casino. Minor remaster.

name: Rancho East Hideout
description: Adds a new player home with interactions, and a cat of course!

name: OnShore - Home
description: Custom home for V at the shore.

name: Rocky Ridge Garage Safehouse
description: Add a new home/garage in Rocky Ridge.

name: h10 v.1
description: a nice clean h10 for a nice clean netrunner. usable netrunner chair with ability to change appearance, and ice bath inside the secret room. wardrobe prompt is in the same spot, but now is the fridge. tons of smartframes, and open bed window

name: Dicky Twisters Enhanced
description: Dicky Twisters has been Enhanced! Now with an Improved Parking Lot, More Signage and even Improved Interior Club Lighting, we know your visit will be memorable!!! Cum get twisted with us anytime of the day! (:

name: Lizzie Walk Garage - Liberty Walk Garage Inspired -
description: A Liberty Walk Garage Inspired, using the IRL location for reference.

name: Dark Neon - Glen Apartment Overhaul
description: The Glen Apartment designed with a bit of a maximalist take to give a real cyberpunk vibe. This is for mercs with a busy life of running and gunning, who focus more on their gear then on pretty furniture.

name: Watson Northside Garage - Workshop
description: This mod will add a new garage to your game. Located in Watson Northside

name: NC Track Circuits - Mount Choombatta (Touge drift)
description: Touge type racing track on an activation toggle. Deja vu ! I've just been in this place before !

name: MURKMAN Cave ( BATMAN )
description: The man that Night City doesn’t deserve, DOES DESERVE the cave of his dreams. Fitted with detective gear, terminals and map of the city, Murkman has EVERYTHING he needs to protect this city from DECAY. On the opposite side is his hangout and workout room and ABOVE THAT are pipes you can use to stay undetected!

name: V's Mansion Redux - NeoZen
description: A noir neokitsch mansion for your V !

name: Rockerdoll Japantown Apartment
description: My take on V's Japantown Apartment, with added interactions, Kitsch/Neokitsch style.

name: Casino Reforged - Phase 1 : Access areas and fixes
description: A collaborative project between multiple mods and authors to restore the North Oak Casino district. This mod grants physical access for V to the zone and introduces several area fixes and improvements.

name: Judy's Lake House - Player Apartment
description: Adds bed, mirror, shower, coffee, stash, closet interactions (and more) to Judy's lake shack.

name: West Wind Estate Beach House
description: West Wind Estate Beach House End of the road – West Wind Estate, Pacifica, Night City.

name: H10 Enhanced
description: Pretty much just fills out some of the empty spaces and adds some lights in MegaBuilding H-10 so it doesn't feel as empty and dark.

name: DBRV Memorial - Goodbye to a friend
description: A memorial to everyone's favourite modding frog. Rest easy Andrii.

name: Improved Aldecaldos Camp
description: Improves the realism of the new Aldecaldos camp (once they moved after the quest Queen of the Highway) with new content and QoL stuff.

name: Sandra Dorsette Apartment
description:
After you helped her recover her databank and scrubbed her name from the corpos' systems,
Sandra Dorsett now considers you someone she can trust.
As a token of gratitude, she’s given you access to her hidden Kabuki apartment.
A quiet, secure place — and more functional than it looks.

name: Empathy Bar Enhanced
description: After Club Owners Adam Ibrahimovic and Larry Fanghorns dispute over “suspicious malware” found on their Clubs Main Computer, the pair broke-up ! With New Management the Club has decided to Renovate the Club and upgrade ALL the Clubs Lighting and Dance Floor ! “Whoever” uploaded that suspicious malware awhile ago to break up the two, THANKS !

name: Drive In Theater ( Working Movie Screen )
description: This Mod Re-Opens the Drive in for all the Movie-Goers who needed that escape from the harsh reality of Night City! The Drive-In is now FULLY PACKED with Cars, People, Vegetation and a stocked Concession Stand! Enjoy your Movie viewing!

name: Room 206 (Rent a Motel)
description: Rent a Motel lets you stay for the night or the week at several motels including the room 206 at no tell motel.

name: Dogtown - The Moth's rooftop apartment
description: This mod adds an apartment on the empty floor above The Moth's bar in Dogtown, fully refurbished and with native interactions.

name: Dandelion Cocktail Bar Enhanced
description: This is a SMALL but awesome little mod Enhancing the Dandelion Cocktail Bar I found one day running around Night City ! Now it STANDS OUT with the matching Green Lights, Arcade Machines and even a Player Stash ! The New Decorations and Native interactions now makes this lil Bar feel like an actual spot to visit now !

name: Japantown North Verticality Expanded
description: Drastically expands the vertical space in the north of Japantown by connecting several existing pedestrian walkways to the main game world and adding new interior spaces in between.

name: Afterlife Unlocked and Remastered
description: Unlocked and enhanced the look of Afterlife club.

name: Under the sun
description: Hidden deep in the dusty Badlands, Under the Sun adds a mysterious new location to Cyberpunk 2077: the abandoned Strange Insight Radio Station, a forgotten voice of truth and rebellion once broadcasting freely beyond the city’s walls.

name: Glen Rockerboy Apartment (world edit)
description: The Glen apartment has had a makeover to fit music lovers, in particular Rockerboys. Features new décor, memorabilia, and interactions.

name: V's Santo Domingo Safehouse
description: Player compound in Rancho Coronado with several amenities.

name: The Zenitex Military Store
description: Welcome to Zenitex. Adds a lore-friendly faction with a unique aesthetic, interior location, vendors, NPCs and collectible data. Purchase Zenitex equipment at up to 50% discount.

name: H10 Elevator Expanded
description: Overhauls megabuilding H10's exterior elevator, adding additional stops and floors

name: The Afterlife Overhaul
description: I brought it back, the first mod I ever created. The Afterlife overhaul is exactly what it is.

name: The Atlantis - Restored
description: Reopens The Atlantis from Johnny's flashback. Unlocks club entrance, adds real NPC, interactable bartenders, and fast travel point to the location.

name: V's Modest Netrunner Apartment
description: Overhaul of V's H10 apartment with additional netrunning room

name: TactiCool V's H10 Apartment
description: Improved V's H10 apartment. All the tactical needs you desire in the bed or out in the field.

name: Bliss club Jigjig Street Changes
description: This is a minimal mod that changes some things with the Bliss club on Jigjig street.

name: Heavy Heart Vip Room Appartment
description: Heavy Heart Vip Room Appartment Heavy Earth – Just across from Mr. Hand’s Room, Night City.

name: Golden Glen Apartment - ArchiveXL
description: A makeover of V's Glen apartment inspired by Jackie and the Valentinos. Style: neokitsch/neomilitary

name: EL Cojote Cojo Unlocked
description: Unlocked the locked areas in the bar with minor fixes. Unlocked Jackie's garage as an option.

name: No-Tell Motel Upper Floors Unlocked
description: Unlocks and repairs the upper floors of the No-Tell Motel.

name: Corpo Plaza Garage - Redux
description: Among the benefits of urban planning is taking trouble spots and turning them into amenities for our hard-working citizens. Why live next to trash, dirt, rust and gang graffities when you can take away an underutilized space and give it back to the most important group of our community: rich tenants.

name: Crunch Plaza Expanded
description: Crunch Plaza has been Expanded and Enhanced! Be sure to Get some VIP Parking, take in the beautiful sights and Visit the NEW Shooting Range!

name: Lucy Apartment Remastered 2025
description: Edgerunners Lucy's apartment in the location from the anime with the signature look out of the window and from the roof.

name: Regina's NCPD Headquarters
description: It seems helping Regina with the Cyberphyscos problem REALLY DID pay off in the end: She’s been “Hired” by the NCPD and the “Official” Headquarters is now FULLY DECKED OUT with NCPD Tracking Equipment, Display Screens and even a BRAND NEW AV Landing Pad on the Roof for easy access to the HQ ! Night City WILL, BE SAVE UNDER OUR EYES !

name: Dogtown Natural History Museum Enhanced
description: Enhances the Organitopia natural history museum in the south of Dogtown by adding several new fossils and fixes.

name: Riot Club Unlocked and Remastered
description: Riot Club unlocked and enhanced.

name: Vault 404 ( Fallout Shelter )
description: WELCOME VAULT DWELLER to your new home!.........FOREVER! Vault 404 is proudly funded by the Vault-Tec AND Arasaka Corporation ensuring you have EVERYTHING YOU NEED to live a FULL LIFE in complete isolation! Vault-Tec ensures our Vault dwellers have a Room of their own, a Green Room, Gym and their very own Bathroom! What more can you need?!?!?!

name: Santo Domingo Garage Home
description: WE'RE LIVIN' IN SANTO DOMINGO CHOOMBA!!! This mod reworks what was a closed off and destroyed building right by the gun store and ripperdoc at the bottom of the SanDom dam. Has native interactions.

name: Arroyo Safehouse
description: An unassuming safehouse right in the middle of Arroyo, right past Red Dirt bar. Need to be purchased first on the terminal right by the front door

name: Tengu Garage and Dojo
description: A tight bike garage with a hangout and a touch of Zen. AMM

name: Hanami - japantown (japanese restaurant)
description: japanese restaurant in japantown

name: Dogtown Sewer Hideout
description: Adds a new player home with interactions. Since this is Dogtown, you live in the gutter, literally. And no, Panam doesn't want to stay at your house... Oh well, it still beats waiting for elevators, and nobody expects you to pay rent!

name: JUNGLE RUNNER - H10 Apartment
description: Space themed decoration for Apartment H10. Designed for a netrunner who loves plants. Available standalone or as AMM preset.

name: Yaiba Bike Showroom
description: WELCOME BACK to the Yaiba Bike Showroom ! This is ALMOST an exact copy of the area from the Mission "Nitro Youth Energy" with an AV Landing Pad, Added Back Sitting Area and Parking Lot! Stop by this Luxurious Showroom, check out the latest and greatest models of most Cyberpunk bikes, and even use a computer to buy some vehicles while you're here !

name: Tucker Albachs Apartment Enhanced
description: After dealing with Tucker Albach, her Apartment was listed under her next of kin, ( secretly changed to V ) SO CONGRATS on your new Apartment given to you by your loving family member ! It has been Enhanced with Better Lighting, Roof AV Landing Pad and even your own Room catered to its Style ! Truthfully a place worthy of V, and not Tucker Albach...

name: Handsome Squidward (Brainporium - Dogtown)
description: Replaces the Brainporium sculpture building in Dogtown with Handsome Squidward.

name: Little China Apartment (Usable from Act 1)
description: An Apartment on the edge of Little China with both a fully furnished and also 2 non decorated versions to build with AMM or World Builder one is just the building

name: Pacifica Hotel Pistis Sophia Apartment
description: The same floor where Johnny takes V after the Dashi Parade, but different apartment, with great view to the Pacifica Pier.

name: Satellite Tower Apartment (in trailer park)
description:
Did you ever want to live in an abandoned communications tower in a trailer park? Well of course not, but now you can! 
Turns out you're too stinky even for the trailer park. Thankfully the good people gave you this abandoned place.

name: Japantown Rooftop Mansion
description: This Luxury Japantown Mansion is now fitted with an AV Landing Pad and an entire Top Floor Garden with AMAZING views!

name: NC Beats - Player Home and Radio EXT Station
description: Meticulously crafted Player home, and curated Radio EXT Station, with stream friendly music and DJ voice work. Reworked with WB and Native Interactions. Also some custom followers for AMM

name: Casino Reforged - Phase 2 : Access Road and Entrance
description: North Oaks Resort and Casino. All new interior, updated access road, car park and Casino entrance - Phase 2 of the Casino Reforged project

name: Japantown Garage
description: Adds a two car garage to V's Japantown Apartment. Removes construction debris and adds an accessible door inside added garage.

name: Underground Casino ( Working Roulette )
description: This Mod brings more attention to the Underground Casino from the Gig: Tyger and Vulture. Now with added street detail you'll never miss the Casino driving by again! Inside the Casino feature lights to set the mood and Holo Fish Tanks to look at while gambling!

name: Totentanz Club Enhanced
description: WELCOME BACK TO HELL! While Maelstorm Crimes are soaring, so is V on their way up to the Newly Enhanced Club! Fitted with Red Lights to match the Gangs Theme, Data Screens displaying the Gangs Illicit activities on the Black Market and even a MAXXED OUT Club Vibe, Thanks to the BURNING Passion of DJ Tinnitus endorsing the Club Renovations!

name: JUNGLE RUNNER - H10 Apt - Enhanced
credits: Brocreate  (Jungle Runner is a remix of Brocreate’s DIGITAL OASIS)
description: Space greenhouse decor for apartment H10. Adding 5 new Smart Frames (7 total available) and 10 interactions : drink coffee and tea, eat yakitori, play guitar, use netrunner chair, meditate, etc.

name: Cliffside Abode Player Home
description: This mod adds a Corpo style retreat player home on a cliffside overlooking a canyon. It has Native Interactions and was inspired by Outdoor V Canyon by Ka0ziun. Version 10 adds a dockside area. Special thanks to MorganLeFaye79 for her props mod Victorian Style Sofa

name: The Glen Windows addon - Interactive Shutters
description: Small addition to have some interactive shutters at every windows from The Glen apartment. Compatible with most if not every Glen overhaul mods. With switches to control all shutters at once.

name: Hobo's El Coyote Dumpster crib
description: Visit one of my digs by El Coyote. :) (first attempt at WB/NIF mods) :)))

name: Denny's Villa Enchanced
description: Unlock Denny's villa and add some interaction and nex rooms.

name: Santo Domingo Overlook - Artistic Safehouse
description: Flip an unfinished, empty room in a backwater building in Santo Domingo, turn it into an artistic apartment/safehouse.

name: Kabuki tech terrarium - apartment
description: Dark techy hideout with a view

name: Konpeki Plaza Expanded ( with Apartment )
description: The Konpeki Plaza has RE-OPENED AND EXPANDED! Now Featuring Vegetation, Statues, Lights and even a FULL BAR! Below is the Garage with plenty of space! On the 44th floor is the AV Pad and the Apartments where you'll find your room welcoming you back to Konpeki Plaza!

name: Crystal Palace Resort
description: WELCOME! The Crystal Palace Resort is now OPEN 24/7 hovering over Night City waiting for your arrival! The Resort has everything a RICH CORPO needs for a getaway, Shopping Strip, Casino/Resort, Pools and an Outdoor Kitchen! Feel free to Fly A Vehicle up to the Resort Landing Strip anytime OR take the NEW Fast Travel Station via Street Level !

name: Talent Academy Enhanced
description: WELCOME BACK to the Talent Academy! After V's Deal with Fiona Vargas, she has given you access to her Personal Apartment below the Club! Feel Free to visit whenever, grab a drink and HOPEFULLY see some New, Next Level Talent formed...if they ever fix that Display case from Tommy....

name: Biotechnica Hotel Enhanced ( with Apartment )
description: After the "Mysterious" passing of Joanne Koch, the Biotechnica Hotel has Enhanced their entire Hotel with Better Visibility and even started letting Clients back to rent a room again ! BIOTECHNICA WELCOMES YOU BACK and even invites you to Joanne's old room! The NEW AV Landing Pad added on the Roof will let Clients come and go as they please !

name: Gaston Slaytons Apartment Enhanced
description: After Gaston Slaytons Apartment was "Mysteriously" robbed, he was so scared of the rest of his PRIZE POSSESIONS being stolen in the future, that he bolted out of Night City ! "Whoever" robbed them ended up scoring you his DOPE Apartment ! Fully Decorated with better Lighting like a Psychofan would and decked out with Samuri Merch on all the walls !

name: Lina Malina house enchanced
description: Lina Malina house enhanced with new interactions.

name: the glen v.1 apartment
description: bold flashy neon glen redesign with wraparound balcony

name: Petrel st unit - apartment
description: cozy brick rocker apartment

name: Charterhill Skatepark
description: The Skatepark is open 24/7 for REAL CYBERPSYCHOS to go berserk in! Happily funded by the Adverts of Night City, provides City Wide Access all year round for all residents! (; The Skatepark Features multiple different ramp types to ride and do Stunts on!

name: Canyon construction ramp
description: Adds an access ramp down to the bottom of the canyon.

name: Safehouses of Night City - V's Northside Autoshop
description: It’s a garage in a warehouse in the Northside part of the Watson district.Now includes more interactions including smartframes, arcade machines, basketball, sleep, shower, ect.

name: H10 - Tidy Your Trash - Modular Apartment Makeover
description: Another attempt to tidy up the H10 apartment. The aim of this one wasn't to remove all the trash, but instead to make it look like V can walk to a bin every once in a while.The mod also includes options to redecorate, allowing you to

name: Northside - Tidy Your Trash - Modular Apartment Makeover
description: Another attempt to tidy up the Northside apartment. The aim of this one wasn't to remove all the trash, but instead to make it look like V can walk to a bin every once in a while. They've also gone out and bought some cleaning supplies and

name: Japantown - Tidy Your Trash - Modular Apartment Makeover
description: Another attempt to tidy up the Japantown apartment. The aim of this one wasn't to remove all the trash, but instead to make it look like V can walk to a bin every once in a while.The mod also includes options to redecorate certain areas.

name: Glen - Tidy Your Trash - Modular Apartment Makeover
description: Another attempt to tidy up the Glen apartment. The aim of this one wasn't to remove all the trash, but instead to make it look like V can walk to a bin every once in a while.The mod also includes options to redecorate certain areas.

name: Atari Canyon - Blade Runner
description: A bit more Blade Runner. Adds Atari hologram ads created by BillZarro﻿ to several locations in the City Center.

name: Kujira - Rafale-F22-F35
description: New aircraft models for B1W’s Kujira supercarrier : Rafale, F-22, and F-35. Variant with F117s.

name: Stone Manor Player Home
description: Once belonging to an heir of Arasaka, This house is looking for its third owner. It's Paradise.

name: The Hollywood Cliffhanger Player Mansion
description: A Magnificent Modern Wonder Home for Night City!
